'''April 2001 Fort Collins tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Marshak's House of Fantasy, Ft. Collins, Colorado on 21 April 2001. [[John Arendt]] won it. It is known from Jason Keen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2234">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-ft-collins-co-4-21-01-niiiice-trd2234/ ft-collins-co-4-21-01-niiiice-tr], DeckTech (Jason "Qui" Keen, 5 May 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-05-05-ft-collins-co-4-21-01-niiiice-trd2234/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Marshak's House of Fantasy, Ft. Collins, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[John Arendt]]
